title: IDEEL- UNC Implemented 4CAST Modification (Nextera Library Preparation Protocol)
author: Infectious Disease Epidemiology and Ecology Lab
materials: Calculate the amount of reagents needed for the number of samples to be run plus 3 additional reactions for controls. Use a 10% excess to account for pipette loss.
Equilibrate SPRI beads to room temperature.
Aspirate and dispose of ethanol wash.

steps.title: Reconstitute primers
steps.instruction: Reconstitute all primers to a 100 µM stock according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Prepare primer mixture
steps.instruction: Combine 10 µL of each 100 µM forward and reverse primer for CSP, AMA1, SERA2, and TRAP in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, then dilute 1:1 with molecular‑grade water (MGW) to obtain a working concentration of 6.250 µM for each primer.

steps.title: Thaw reagents and record UDI
steps.instruction: Thaw the pre‑combined UDI 96‑well plate, purified PCR reaction mix, KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix, and SPRI beads; record which combinatorial index plate is being used (e.g., UDI‑A1).

steps.title: Prepare master mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a master mix per reaction with 5.0 µL KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix 2X, 1.5 µL primer cocktail, and 0 µL water to a total of 6.5 µL; add 10 % excess volume, then dispense 7.0 µL master mix into each well.

steps.title: Add genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Add 4.0 µL genomic DNA (or negative/positive control) to each well and gently mix by pipetting up and down three times.

steps.title: Program and run PCR1
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler for PCR1 (lid temperature 105 °C and the remaining cycling conditions as specified in the protocol) and run the reaction.

steps.title: Spin down PCR1 plate
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the PCR1 plate to collect all liquid at the bottom of the wells.

steps.title: PCR1 SPRI bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform SPRI bead cleanup of PCR1 amplicons:

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL SPRI beads to each well (no mixing required); cover with a plate seal and vortex gently.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 min.
Place the plate on a 96‑well magnetic rack for 2 min to capture beads.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant.
Spin the plate briefly to ensure beads are at the bottom.
Prepare fresh 80 % ethanol (mix 200‑proof ethanol with molecular‑grade water to give 100 µL of 80 % ethanol per sample).
Dispense 50 µL 80 % ethanol into each well, incubate 30 s at room temperature, then aspirate and discard.
Resuspend beads with 10 µL MGW, incubate 5 min at room temperature to elute amplicons.
Place on the magnetic rack for 1 min, then transfer the eluate to a clean plate.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more (total of two washes).
Aspirate any remaining ethanol with P20 tips.
Transfer purified amplicons to a clean plate and store short‑term at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 80 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Mix fresh 80 % ethanol using 200‑proof ethanol and molecular‑grade water; each sample will require 100 µL total ethanol.

steps.title: Pool purified amplicons
steps.instruction: Combine approximately 8 µL of each purified amplicon into a 2.0 mL Eppendorf tube (use 3 µL per sample for high‑throughput). If fewer than 13 samples are processed, adjust the volume per sample (e.g., 10 µL) to obtain an adequate pool volume. Mix gently and spin down.

steps.title: Size‑select pooled library
steps.instruction: Perform SPRI bead size‑selection on the pooled library:

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of the combined pool into a PCR tube and add 55 µL SPRI beads; mix well.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 min.
Place on a magnetic rack for 3 min.
Transfer the clear supernatant to a new PCR tube (keep supernatant).
Add 20 µL SPRI beads to the supernatant, mix well, and incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Place on the magnetic rack for 3 min.
While on the magnet, discard the supernatant and wash the beads twice with ~150 µL 80 % ethanol each.
Elute the DNA in 30 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8.0 (if using a 1 M Tris stock, dilute 1 µL into 99 µL water). Incubate 3 min, then place on the magnetic rack for ~1 min to separate beads.
Transfer the eluate to a clean 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Add 2.5 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl containing 0.05 % Tween‑20 for final suspension.
Freeze the pooled library at –20 °C.

steps.title: Add UDI indices
steps.instruction: Add 2.2 µL of the appropriate 10 µM UDI to each well of the library‑prep plate.

steps.title: Add PCR1 product to library prep
steps.instruction: Add 3.0 µL of the PCR1 product to each well, then seal the plate thoroughly.

steps.title: Program and run library‑prep PCR
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler for the Library Preparation PCR (lid temperature 105 °C and the cycling conditions specified in the protocol) and run the reaction.

steps.title: Spin plates before opening
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the UDI plate and the purified PCR1 plate briefly to ensure all liquid is at the bottom before opening.

steps.title: Equilibrate beads and reagents
steps.instruction: Allow SPRI beads to equilibrate to room temperature for 30 min; also bring any Tapestation reagents from 4 °C to room temperature before use.

steps.title: Final library QC (optional)
steps.instruction: Perform Qubit HS dsDNA quantitation and Agilent D1000 TapeStation analysis on the final library to confirm concentration and fragment size (full qPCR quantification is not required for 4CAST).
